label: Bing Reverse Image Search API
title: Bing Reverse Image Search API: Similar Images & Pages
metaDescription: Reverse image search on Bing from a link or an uploaded file: best guess, similar images, pages that carry the image, text in the picture and a description.
intro: Give it an image link or upload a file and get Bing's best guess, hundreds of visually similar images with sizes and dates, the pages that carry the image, related searches, the text inside the picture and an AI description.
useCases: Find unlicensed copies of your photos
Trace the original source of an image
Identify products or places in a picture

faq.q: How do I reverse image search with Bing in bulk?
faq.a: Give it a list of image links (or upload files) and it returns, for each picture, Bing's best guess, visually similar images and the pages where the picture appears.

faq.q: Can I find where my photos are used online?
faq.a: Yes. The "pages with this image" results list the web pages carrying the picture, with titles and dates, which is how photographers and brands trace reuse.

faq.q: Does it read text in the picture?
faq.a: Yes. Every line of text Bing can read, with where it sits on the picture, plus Bing's short AI description with sources.

faq.q: Can I upload a file instead of a link?
faq.a: Yes: image links, uploaded files or data: links. Large pictures are resized automatically.

faq.q: Do I need a Bing Visual Search API key?
faq.a: No. That API was retired in 2025; this actor needs no Azure key.

officialApi: Microsoft retired the Bing Search APIs, including Image Search and Visual Search, in August 2025; the replacement 'Grounding with Bing' only works inside Azure AI agents and returns no raw results. This actor gives you Bing's visual search results for any image, no key.
